name: Columbus, fourth voyage
traveler: Christopher Columbus and his son Fernando
summary: Old and ill, Columbus searches for a strait through to the Indian Ocean along the coast of Central America. He finds gold in Veragua and a Maya trading canoe, but worm-eaten ships strand him on Jamaica for a year.

stops.note: A great Maya trading canoe laden with cloth, copper and cacao.
'Thanks be to God': clear of a month of storms.
Gold, and tales of another sea nine days' march away.
The first settlement on the mainland is driven out by the Ngäbe.
The ships are beached, rotten; a year marooned.
Home. He dies in 1506, still sure he reached Asia.
